_comment: chimera.visible_monkey.dir_spec.v1 -- THE CONTRACT the landed Visible Monkey data must satisfy. Copy to dir_spec.json, fill the real paths, run: python -B tools/science_funnel/visible_monkey_import.py build dir_spec.json. Nothing else is edited; every field here is load-bearing and refuses by name if wrong.
_root_note: absolute path to the landed data (operator email -> this dir, then sha256 everything per RUNBOOK step 1)

stl._note: Kim et al. 2020: 167 whole-body structures, 3D STL surface models (Mimics 17.01). expected_count is a falsifier: any other count refuses structure_count_mismatch.

labels._note: CSV with a header row; id matches the STL filename stem. system is one of the materials_by_system keys. stated_volume_mm3 is OPTIONAL: when present (e.g. from the segmentation tables), mesh-integrated volume must agree within volume_tolerance_rel or the translator refuses volume_mismatch.

collection_record._note: see collection_record.template.json -- the STAGE GATE lives here (age evidence admission-required)

adjacency._note: MEASURED structure-to-structure contacts only (pair of ids + gap_mm). The real set ships none until adjacency is measured (successor work); absent file => zero bonds, honest components, zero invented joints.

_fraction_note: when true (REAL data), the book's system fractions are gated: skeleton 8-15% of the collection-record body mass (mammalian band), muscle 25-50%; the whole-animal band [0.6, 1.3] x body mass is always gated when body_mass_kg is present. Synthetic fixtures set false -- they prove the identity machinery, not biology.

materials_by_system._note: every STL's system must map here; densities and their citations live in the translator's MATERIALS (Rule 1), not in the spec

_output_note: output_dir receives body.json + tris/*.bin; validation_dir receives derivation.json + verify.json. Both must be OUTSIDE the repo (bulk data never lands in git); the repo receives only receipts and the runbook's appended REAL verify record.
